turn_text: I think the most important thing that we can do, and I want to thank Bob for his work trying to make this happen, is to create an environment in which Republican senators can vote for climate legislation without fear. There's been an enormous shift recently, and some of the strongest deniers of climate change have backed off and indeed are supporting small climate bills. There's a lot of bipartisan legislation that is happening on climate, but it's along the margins. And if you want to do something that's actually going to address the 1.5 or 2 degrees problem and keep us within those safety bounds, then Republicans are going to need to feel safe
